owner_rules: Done means ALL evidence: implemented as specified (task id), a test that FAILED before and passes now, suites green, measured number vs target, docs regenerated, committed AND pushed to the contract's branch.
Never defer: no "later", "follow-up", "out of scope". If blocked: what blocks, what you tried, what you need; then continue with the next task.
Root cause, then fix: file:line + mechanism. No weakening tests, raising timeouts, skips, relaxed assertions.
No silent scope cuts: never lower targets, caps or test sizes without owner approval.
Never bypass guards: no --no-verify, no bypass env vars, no skip flags.
Deliver continuously: one task per commit, pushed to the contract's branch as it goes green.
Honest reporting: TASK-ID | status | commit | tests | measured vs target | missing.

tasks.title: Provider-neutral execution adapter contract: the module and its conformance test (the gaps SO-1.04, SO-05-B and SO-08-B leave open)
requirements: MV-S1-05: Provider-neutral execution adapters: discovery, session lifecycle, dispatch, checkpoint, progress, cancellation, recovery. (source: owner notes of 31 Oct 2026, docs/scope-one/programme/REQUIREMENTS.md:112; evidence docs/scope-one/programme/DECOMPOSITION.md:137; baseline 8.2)

SO-1.04 requirement 1: "Define one adapter contract with declared capabilities, identity, session discovery, dispatch, progress/result reporting, checkpointing, cancellation semantics and recovery." (source: contract SO-1.04 T1)

SO-1.04 requirement 2: "Keep provider-specific behaviour inside adapters; the planner and coordinator must consume capability declarations rather than provider-specific conditionals." (source: contract SO-1.04 T1)
SO-1.04 requirement 4: "Never report successful completion merely because a provider returned a success-shaped response." (source: contract SO-1.04 T1)

SO-A-03 (signed fold contract, cited by id; pull request #341) owns the four execution event kinds requested, accepted, observed and verified, and the guard that observation precedes verification; this task cites it and does not restate it (source: pull request #341, WBS.md section 9.2)
tasks.description: Repo: memev. Specifies only what is not already specified. SO-1.04 decides the contract but is a design record and builds nothing; the per-client capability records are signed vault contract SO-05-B and the cancellation flow is signed vault contract SO-08-B (both cited by id; neither is delivered on main). This task builds the execution adapter contract module and the suite that any adapter must pass, reads capability from the SO-05-B record and defines no second record, and leaves the event distinction (SO-1.04 requirement 3) and the pause and cancel flow to those contracts. SO-2.08 holds the adapter for each framework and runtime that implements this contract. SO-A-03 builds the four event kinds of SO-1.04 requirement 3 (requested, accepted, observed, verified); this task builds none of them.

tasks.description: Repo: memev. Specifies only the gap.
